description: Check a product's ingredient list against the allergies of one or more people in a household. Catches allergens listed under other names (e.g. "arachis oil" for peanut, "casein" for milk, Latin plant names in cosmetics) and does not let "free from" claims hide a real ingredient. Covers food and cosmetics. Use when the user asks if a product or ingredient list is safe for someone with allergies.

household.description: One entry per person, each with their allergens.

allergens.description: Allergens in plain words, e.g. "peanut", "milk", "fragrance", "nickel". Add a severity to rank alerts.

person.description: Who this is for, e.g. "me", "Ava", "Dad". Optional.

ingredients.description: The product's ingredient list, or the product page text that contains it.

product_name.description: Product name, for the answer only.

name: check_product_allergens
title: Check a product for allergens
